settings.closeToTray: Minimize to tray when closing the window (instead of quitting)
settings.pollHint: Shorter interval applies rules faster at slightly higher CPU cost.
settings.showAdvanced: Show advanced priorities (I/O / Memory) in the rule editor

ruleImport.policyMismatch: GPU policy currently pins {current}, differs from best {best}
ruleImport.noCores: No cores remain after exclusion — cannot import
ruleImport.staleHardware: This recommendation is from different CPU hardware (fingerprint mismatch). Data preserved but may not apply.
ruleImport.annotatedFrom: Annotated from a GPU benchmark recommendation
ruleImport.affinityNote: Imported game CPU affinity always reserves the best GPU core; core 0 is additionally excluded only when at least six physical cores remain.

gpuTest.adaptiveSchedule: The benchmark always excludes physical core 0. Adaptive schedule: 2 screening rounds test every selected core, then 3 to 5 paired confirmation rounds retest only the top two cores. Confirmation may extend from 3 to 5 rounds when evidence is not yet decisive.
gpuTest.fullscreenResolutionHint: Fullscreen uses the current display resolution
gpuTest.errSample: Sample seconds must be greater than 0
gpuTest.riskBody:
The driver of {gpu} will be restarted repeatedly (up to {count} times); the screen may go black during testing.

For accurate results, close the following before starting:
• Games, browsers, and other GPU hardware-accelerated apps
• Recording, streaming, overlays, and monitoring tools
• Downloads, updates, and other high-load background work

Do not operate the computer during the test.
gpuTest.activeWarningZh: 請勿操作電腦以免影響測試結果
gpuTest.activeWarningEn: Do not operate the computer to avoid affecting results
gpuTest.partialError: Some core data was missing — no recommendation
gpuTest.applyBestConfirm: Set GPU interrupt affinity to core {lp} ({gpu})? The screen may blink for a few seconds.
gpuTest.restoreConfirm: Restore the GPU interrupt affinity from before the last apply?
gpuTest.policyMismatch: Current GPU pin is core {current}, different from this result's best core {best}.
gpuTest.noBest: This session has no best core
gpuTest.deleteConfirm: Delete this benchmark session? (files cannot be recovered)
gpuTest.recoveryBanner: A previous GPU change was not fully restored. Restart FrameAnchor or restore manually before starting a new test or applying.
gpuTest.manualApplyConfirmBody: Set GPU interrupt affinity of {gpu} to core {lp}? The screen may blink for a few seconds.
gpuTest.reliabilityPassedSummary: Passed the reliability gate and can be applied.
gpuTest.reliabilityEquivalentSummary: Stable and repeatable, but the candidate's advantage is too small to apply.
gpuTest.reliabilityInconclusiveSummary: The result is inconclusive and not reliable enough to apply.
gpuTest.reliabilityUnassessedSummary: This is a legacy or unassessed result and cannot be applied.
gpuTest.reliabilityEvidenceNote: Confirmation evidence uses only the independent paired rounds of the top two cores (screening data is never mixed in). The stability interval is a deterministic paired-bootstrap decision heuristic over 3–5 rounds — not a confidence interval and not a significance test.

errors.SET_AFFINITY_FAILED: CPU affinity failed (may be anti-cheat protected)
errors.UPDATE_CHECK_FAILED: Update check failed (network error or GitHub API unreachable)
errors.GPU_REGISTRY_FAILED: Failed to access GPU interrupt affinity settings
errors.GPU_RESTART_FAILED: Failed to restart the display device
errors.GPU_BASIC_DISPLAY_DISABLED: Basic display fallback driver is disabled — cannot safely apply
errors.GPU_RESTORE_FAILED: Failed to restore the previous GPU interrupt affinity
errors.GPU_APPLY_FAILED: Failed to apply the recommended GPU interrupt affinity
errors.BENCHMARK_SESSION_NOT_COMPLETED: Benchmark session is not completed yet
errors.BENCHMARK_RELIABILITY_NOT_PASSED: Benchmark result is not reliable enough to apply — run with at least 3 rounds
errors.BENCHMARK_SESSION_INCOMPATIBLE: Benchmark result does not match this CPU or GPU
errors.BENCHMARK_RECOVERY_REQUIRED: A previous GPU change was not fully restored. Restart FrameAnchor or restore manually before continuing
errors.BENCHMARK_NOT_IMPLEMENTED: Benchmark runner is not implemented yet
errors.BENCHMARK_ASSETS_MISSING: Benchmark tools are missing (run the asset build/fetch step)
errors.BENCHMARK_ASSETS_HASH_MISMATCH: Benchmark tool checksum mismatch — tools may be corrupted
errors.BENCHMARK_WORKLOAD_FAILED: Failed to launch the benchmark workload
errors.BENCHMARK_CSV_INVALID: Benchmark capture data was missing or invalid
errors.BENCHMARK_PRESENTMON_TIMEOUT: PresentMon did not exit in time — a stale capture session may be blocking it. Close other PresentMon processes and retry
errors.BENCHMARK_CAPTURE_MISSING: Workload produced no capturable frames — the display driver may not be ready yet, or an automatic retry was attempted but still failed
errors.BENCHMARK_CAPTURE_EMPTY: Workload produced no frame data — the capture was empty even after retry
errors.BENCHMARK_CAPTURE_ETW_LOST: PresentMon lost too many ETW events — capture load is too high. Close overlays, GPU monitoring, or recording tools, then retry
errors.anticheatNote: This game is anti-cheat protected. Keep FrameAnchor running before launching the game; if it's already running, restart the game.
